## Objective
- Build a complete, playable game from the user’s prompt about playing a TV game quietly while parents sleep.
- Implement a safe, non-violent catch outcome; the game currently pauses/ends the round if Dad catches the player.

## Requirements
- Build the game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Support PS5 controller input and responsive mobile layouts.
- Save a small JPEG screenshot for checks and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created “Quiet Quest — Midnight Mode,” a 2D illustrated midnight-room stealth arcade game rather than a full 3D game.
- Replaced belt violence with a harmless round-over state and explanatory text.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added playable browser game, room scene, TV targets, noise meter, volume remote, Dad attention mechanic, score goal, timer, keyboard/mouse/touch/gamepad controls.
- Added responsive layout and a help modal.
- Verified `game.js` parses with `node --check game.js`.
- Opened the game in Playwright and inspected its page snapshot and JPEG screenshot.

### Active
- Confirm browser gameplay and responsive layout after latest small changes to `game.js` and `index.html`.

### Blocked
- Browser check reported no game errors; earlier sole console error was missing `/favicon.ico`, now addressed with an inline data favicon, but not rechecked.

## Next Move
1. Reopen/reload `http://localhost:3002` and verify the favicon and recent `game.js` edit.
2. Check interactive target hits and the mobile layout; adjust if needed.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game page structure and inline favicon.
- `style.css`: Theme, layout, and responsive styling.
- `game.js`: Game logic, canvas scene, controls, and gamepad polling.
- `screenshots/quiet-quest.jpg`: Latest saved check screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Local server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Playwright check at `1280x800` showed the main game panel; at `390x844`, the start button sits below the initial viewport, but the document has no horizontal overflow.
